originalGroup.label: A boat on the card
originalGroup.sourceNotice: 2026-10-24新题批次 b103；原创候选，非高考真题；自审及程序检查，不声称独立教师或学生稳定性验证。
originalGroup.material:
A boat on the card

The first line is already in position 1. Put the other five lines in positions 2–6 to make one complete conversation.

(1) A: Let’s make a birthday card for Dad.

(____) B: What shall we draw on the front?

(____) A: How about his old sailing boat?

(____) B: Great. We can use it to help with the shape.

(____) A: Yes. Here is one from last summer.

(____) B: Good idea. Do you have a photo of it?

questions.instruction: Read all six lines. Speakers A and B take turns. The first line is given. Choose position 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 for each remaining line.
questions.prompt: What is the position of this line? “B: What shall we draw on the front?”
